options.content:
**How to read this dashboard**

- AI lines/tokens/cost totals are company-wide — AI activity carries no project association in the schema. PR counts and PR size are scoped to the selected project(s). **Every "per merged PR" ratio below (AI Lines/PR, Tokens/PR, Cost/PR, and the indexed efficiency trend) is pinned to company-wide PRs on both sides and ignores the Project filter entirely** — scoping only the PR side would shrink the denominator and inflate the ratio whenever a single project is selected. PR Size (p85/median) has no AI-mixing problem, so it stays scoped to the Project filter as normal.
- AI spend and tokens combine two sources: legacy Cursor/Claude-platform records cost and usage directly, while Claude Code (OTel) records them on separate usage tables — both are unioned into one company-wide total.
- MySQL has no built-in percentile function; p85/median below are computed exactly via row-numbering over the full distribution, not approximated.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(lines_added) AS "AI Lines Generated" FROM ai_activities WHERE NOT (provider = 'claude' AND record_kind IS NULL) AND $__timeFilter(date)

panels.description: Total AI tokens consumed, company-wide. Combines input+output tokens from legacy activity records with input+output+cache tokens from Claude Code (OTel) usage records into one total.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ai_tokens_daily AS (
  SELECT date, (input_tokens + output_tokens) AS tokens
  FROM ai_activities WHERE record_kind IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date, (input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens) AS tokens
  FROM ai_model_usages
)
SELECT SUM(tokens) AS "Tokens Burned" FROM ai_tokens_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(date)

panels.title: Tokens Burned (Company-wide)

panels.description: Total estimated AI spend, company-wide. Combines legacy Cursor/Claude-platform cost with Claude Code (OTel) usage cost, the same union used across this dashboard set.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ai_spend_daily AS (
  SELECT date, provider, user_email, account_id, estimated_cost_usd AS cost
  FROM ai_activities WHERE record_kind IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date, provider, user_email, account_id, estimated_cost_usd AS cost
  FROM ai_model_usages
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS "Cost" FROM ai_spend_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(date)

panels.title: Cost (Company-wide)

panels.description: Merged pull requests, scoped to the selected project(s).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "PRs Merged"
FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
WHERE ppm.project_name IN ($project) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)

panels.title: PRs Merged

panels.description: AI lines added ÷ PRs merged, both company-wide. Kept unscoped on both sides deliberately — since AI activity has no project association, scoping only the PR side would inflate the ratio whenever a single project is selected.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(ai.n / NULLIF(prs.n, 0), 1) AS "AI Lines / PR"
FROM
  (SELECT SUM(lines_added) n FROM ai_activities WHERE NOT (provider = 'claude' AND record_kind IS NULL) AND $__timeFilter(date)) ai,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM pull_requests pr WHERE pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)) prs

panels.title: AI Lines / PR (Company-wide)

panels.description: AI tokens consumed ÷ PRs merged, both company-wide, for the same reason as AI Lines / PR above.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ai_tokens_daily AS (
  SELECT date, (input_tokens + output_tokens) AS tokens
  FROM ai_activities WHERE record_kind IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date, (input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens) AS tokens
  FROM ai_model_usages
)
SELECT ROUND(tok.n / NULLIF(prs.n, 0), 0) AS "Tokens / PR"
FROM
  (SELECT SUM(tokens) n FROM ai_tokens_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(date)) tok,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM pull_requests pr WHERE pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)) prs

panels.title: Tokens / PR (Company-wide)

panels.description: AI spend ÷ PRs merged, both company-wide, for the same reason as AI Lines / PR above.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ai_spend_daily AS (
  SELECT date, provider, user_email, account_id, estimated_cost_usd AS cost
  FROM ai_activities WHERE record_kind IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date, provider, user_email, account_id, estimated_cost_usd AS cost
  FROM ai_model_usages
)
SELECT ROUND(spend.cost / NULLIF(prs.n, 0), 2) AS "Cost / PR"
FROM
  (SELECT SUM(cost) cost FROM ai_spend_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(date)) spend,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM pull_requests pr WHERE pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)) prs

panels.title: Cost / PR (Company-wide)

panels.description: The 85th percentile of merged PR size (additions + deletions), scoped to the selected project(s). Computed exactly via row-numbering over the full size distribution, not approximated.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sizes AS (
  SELECT (pr.additions + pr.deletions) AS sz,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (pr.additions + pr.deletions)) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS total
  FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
  WHERE ppm.project_name IN ($project) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)
)
SELECT sz AS "PR Size p85" FROM sizes WHERE rn = CEIL(0.85 * total) LIMIT 1

panels.title: PR Size p85 (lines changed)
Efficiency per Merged PR, Indexed (baseline = first month = 100)

panels.description: Monthly Cost/PR, Tokens/PR, and AI-Lines/PR, each indexed to its own first non-zero month in range (baseline = 100) so the three can be compared on the same trend scale even though they're sourced from different tables that don't necessarily start in the same month. All company-wide on both sides, consistent with the KPI cards above.

targets.rawSql:
WITH spend_d AS (
  SELECT date, provider, user_email, account_id, estimated_cost_usd AS cost
  FROM ai_activities WHERE record_kind IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date, provider, user_email, account_id, estimated_cost_usd AS cost
  FROM ai_model_usages
),
tok_d AS (
  SELECT date, (input_tokens + output_tokens) AS tokens
  FROM ai_activities WHERE record_kind IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date, (input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens) AS tokens
  FROM ai_model_usages
),
monthly_prs AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pr.merged_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS month, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)
  GROUP BY 1
),
monthly_spend AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-01') AS month, SUM(cost) AS v FROM spend_d WHERE $__timeFilter(date) GROUP BY 1),
monthly_tok AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-01') AS month, SUM(tokens) AS v FROM tok_d WHERE $__timeFilter(date) GROUP BY 1),
monthly_lines AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-01') AS month, SUM(lines_added) AS v FROM ai_activities WHERE NOT (provider = 'claude' AND record_kind IS NULL) AND $__timeFilter(date) GROUP BY 1),
filled AS (
  SELECT p.month,
    COALESCE(s.v, 0) / NULLIF(p.n, 0) AS cost_per_pr,
    COALESCE(t.v, 0) / NULLIF(p.n, 0) AS tok_per_pr,
    COALESCE(l.v, 0) / NULLIF(p.n, 0) AS lines_per_pr
  FROM monthly_prs p
  LEFT JOIN monthly_spend s ON s.month = p.month
  LEFT JOIN monthly_tok t ON t.month = p.month
  LEFT JOIN monthly_lines l ON l.month = p.month
)
SELECT month,
  ROUND(cost_per_pr * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT cost_per_pr FROM filled f WHERE f.cost_per_pr > 0 ORDER BY f.month LIMIT 1), 0), 1) AS `Cost / PR`,
  ROUND(tok_per_pr * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT tok_per_pr FROM filled f WHERE f.tok_per_pr > 0 ORDER BY f.month LIMIT 1), 0), 1) AS `Tokens / PR`,
  ROUND(lines_per_pr * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT lines_per_pr FROM filled f WHERE f.lines_per_pr > 0 ORDER BY f.month LIMIT 1), 0), 1) AS `AI lines / PR`
FROM filled
ORDER BY month

panels.title: Cost / Tokens / AI Lines per PR — Indexed (Company-wide)

panels.description: Monthly p85 (solid) and median (dashed) of merged PR size (additions + deletions), scoped to the selected project(s). A widening gap between the two lines means a small number of oversized PRs are pulling the p85 up while the typical PR stays small — a signal worth watching for review-quality risk.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sizes AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pr.merged_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS month, (pr.additions + pr.deletions) AS sz
  FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
  WHERE ppm.project_name IN ($project) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT month, sz,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY sz) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY month) AS total
  FROM sizes
)
SELECT STR_TO_DATE(month, '%Y-%m-%d') AS time, 'p85' AS metric, sz AS value FROM ranked WHERE rn = CEIL(0.85 * total)
UNION ALL
SELECT STR_TO_DATE(month, '%Y-%m-%d'), 'median', sz FROM ranked WHERE rn = CEIL(0.5 * total)
ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: PR Size: p85 vs Median (lines changed, monthly)
